line_text: The prisoners, my lord.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Basch
line_text: Majesty—

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Ashe
line_text: After what you've done! How dare you! / You're supposed to be dead!

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Judge Ghis
line_text: Come now, come now. Have you forgotten your manners? / This is hardly the courtesy due... / the late Princess Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Vaan
line_text: Princess?

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
line_text: To be sure, she bears no proof of her former station. / No different than any mean member of the insurgence. / The Resistance. / His Excellency the Consul asks the ministry of the disthroned royal family in restoring peace to Dalmasca. / Those who foster instability and unrest, who claim royal blood without proof... / they shall meet their fate at the gallows. There are no exceptions.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Ashe
line_text: I will not play puppet to Vayne.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
line_text: King Raminas entrusted me with a task. / Should the time come, he bade me give you something of great importance. / It is your birthright: the Dusk Shard. / It will warrant the quality of her blood. Only I know where to find it.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Ashe; Basch
line_text: Wait. / You took my father's life! Why spare mine now? You would have me live in shame! / If that is your duty: yes.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Vaan
line_text: Stop being so stubborn! / Keep on like this and you're gonna get us all killed.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Ashe
line_text: Don't interrupt!

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Basch
line_text: Vaan. That stone.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Vaan; Balthier
line_text: It was in the palace treasure. / Well, well.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
line_text: Splendid! You've brought the Stone with you! This spares us a great deal of trouble. / Don't give it to him!

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
line_text: You have to promise: no executions. / A Judge's duty is to the law. / Take them away. Lady Ashe is to be quartered separately.

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: Judge Ghis
line_text: Vayne Solidor. What fascination does this hold for you?

trigger: requested by 監督.リヴァイアサン艦橋にて
speaker: no name shown
line_text: Skip

Such a tremendous honor to again be graced with your presence, Majesty. / You left us with such great dispatch upon our last encounter that I must confess... / I had begun to worry that we may have given Your Majesty some cause for offense. / Such a heartfelt display of remorse.
